حَارِمٌ Denying, refusing, or refusing to give. (TA.) ―
-b2- هُوَ بِحَارِمِ عَقْلٍ, (so in the copies of the K,) or مَا هُوَ بِحَارِمِ عَقْلٍ, (so in the TA,) means He has intellect, or intelligence: (K:) a phrase mentioned, and thus explained, by AZ: and so بِعَارِمِ عَقْلٍ. (TA.) [The right reading is evidently that given in the TA.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
